title: StyleSystem DTCG
description: W3C DTCG-format dimension-axis file (style.<id>.json). Stored as stylesystem.json inside the .apextheme zip. Parsed by StyleSystem::from_dtcg in src-tauri/src/design_system/loader.rs. Every leaf value is a DTCG token { "$type": "...", "$value": ... }. Missing sections and fields fall back to StyleSystem::builtin_default() values so sparse override files work.

Meta.title: Meta
Meta.description: Identity and dark/light preference — parsed directly, not as DTCG tokens.

name.description: Human-readable display name. Falls back to id when absent.

is_dark.description: true for dark-preference systems, false for light. Defaults to true.

DimensionToken.title: DimensionToken
DimensionToken.description: A DTCG dimension or number token. $value is a JSON number (pixels as f32).

IntegerToken.title: IntegerToken
IntegerToken.description: A DTCG integer token for u8 values (0–255). $type is "integer"; $value is an integer 0–255.

TypographySection.title: Typography
TypographySection.description: Font size scale (px as f32) and font-family identifiers. Keys map 1-to-1 with font_xs()..font_xl(), mono_sm()..mono_lg() token functions. Absent keys default per Typography::default().

size_sm.description: Small body / table cell text. Default: 11.0

size_md.description: Medium body — primary reading size. Default: 13.0

mono_sm.description: Monospace small — code, numbers, timestamps. Default: 11.0

mono_lg.description: Monospace large — e.g. price display. Default: 16.0

size_section_label.description: Section / eyebrow label font size. Distinct from size_xs. Default: 9.0

label_tracking.description: Letter-spacing (px) for general tracked-out labels. Default: 0.0

nav_tracking.description: Letter-spacing (px) for toolbar nav button text. Default: 0.0

family_ui.description: UI / proportional family name — body text, labels, headings. Default: "Inter". Must match a font family loaded via the asset workflow (S7).

family_mono.description: Monospace family name — prices, code, timestamps. Default: "JetBrains Mono".

family_display.description: Display / hero family — size_xl hero numerics and headings when serif_headlines=true. Default: "Inter" (fallback to UI family).

SpacingSection.title: Spacing
SpacingSection.description: Layout spacing scale (px as f32). Keys match gap_xs()..gap_2xl() token functions. Absent keys default per Spacing::default().

xs_mid.description: Micro-gap between xs (4px) and sm (8px). Backs gap_xs_mid(). Default: 6.0

gmd.description: Named alias matching the legacy gap_md() token. Default: 8.0

cta_padding_x.description: Primary CTA button horizontal padding. Default: 12.0

RadiiSection.title: Radii
RadiiSection.description: Corner radius scale (px as f32). Keys match radius_xs()..radius_lg() token functions. Absent keys default per Radii::default().

none.description: No rounding — sharp corners (the Meridien aesthetic). Default: 0.0

full.description: Full pill / circular — conceptual maximum. Default: 9999.0

pill.description: Pill radius runtime value (0–99). Meridien=0 (sharp pill), Aperture/Octave=99 (rounded). Default: 99.0

chip.description: Chip/badge corner radius. 0 = use sm. Default: 0.0

StrokesSection.title: Strokes
StrokesSection.description: Stroke / border width scale (px as f32). Keys match stroke_hair()..stroke_thick() token functions. Absent keys default per Strokes::default().

thin.description: Sub-pixel thin border (0.5px). Backs stroke_thin(). Default: 0.5

medium.description: Mid-weight border between thin (0.5px) and std (1.0px). Backs stroke_medium(). Default: 0.8

bold.description: Bold 1.5px emphasis stroke. Backs stroke_bold(). Default: 1.5

md.description: Medium 1.5px stroke (legacy alias — prefer bold). Default: 1.5

heavy.description: Heavy 2px stroke for focus rings / active indicators (legacy alias — prefer thick). Default: 2.0

AlphasSection.title: Alphas
AlphasSection.description: Alpha / opacity scale. u8 fields (0–255) are emitted as IntegerToken ($type: integer); f32 fields (0.0–1.0) are emitted as DimensionToken ($type: number). Both forms are accepted by the loader. Absent keys default per Alphas::default().

faint.description: u8 0-255: Near-invisible overlay (hover shimmer). Backs alpha_faint(). Default: 10

ghost.description: u8 0-255: Ghost — barely visible. Backs alpha_ghost(). Default: 15

soft_u8.description: u8 0-255: Soft muted overlay (disabled states). Backs alpha_soft(). Default: 20

subtle_u8.description: u8 0-255: Subtle low-emphasis overlay. Backs alpha_subtle(). Default: 40

tint.description: u8 0-255: Icon/chip accent tint. Backs alpha_tint(). Default: 48

muted_u8.description: u8 0-255: Primary dimming value. Backs alpha_muted(). Default: 60

dim.description: u8 0-255: Border/line dimming. Backs alpha_dim(). Default: 60

line.description: u8 0-255: Structural line alpha. Backs alpha_line(). Default: 80

strong_u8.description: u8 0-255: Selected row fill. Backs alpha_strong(). Default: 80

active.description: u8 0-255: Interactive element alpha. Backs alpha_active(). Default: 100

heavy_u8.description: u8 0-255: Near-opaque overlay. Backs alpha_heavy(). Default: 120

scrim.description: u8 0-255: Modal-backdrop / cmd-palette dimming. Backs alpha_scrim(). Default: 140

solid.description: u8 0-255: High-opacity element. Backs alpha_solid(). Default: 200

soft.description: f32 0.0-1.0: Soft muted overlay multiplier. Default: 0.12

strong.description: f32 0.0-1.0: Strong multiplier (selected row fill, active chip). Default: 0.72

header_border.description: f32 0.0-1.0: Header outer border alpha. Default: 0.18

ElevationSection.title: Elevation
ElevationSection.description: Gamma / luminance factors for elevation-derived surface colors. Three levels replace hardcoded multiplier sites. Absent keys default per Elevation::default().

l1.description: Level 1: slightly raised (toolbar, column header). >1 brightens in dark themes. Default: 1.05

DensitySection.title: Density
DensitySection.description: Layout density control. factor multiplies spacing/height tokens (1.0=standard, 0.8=compact, 1.2=comfortable). Absent keys default per Density::default().

factor.description: Scale factor applied to row heights and vertical gaps. Default: 1.0

row_height_dense.description: Row height in compact list views (watchlist, scanner). Default: 22.0

row_height_comfortable.description: Row height in comfortable list views. Default: 32.0

ShadowSpecToken.title: ShadowSpecToken
ShadowSpecToken.description: Shadow geometry (no color — color comes from ColorScheme.shadow + Alphas at render time). All fields are dimension tokens.

alpha.description: Alpha multiplier applied on top of ColorScheme.shadow (0.0-1.0).

ShadowsSection.title: Shadows
ShadowsSection.description: Named shadow roles — geometry only, no color. Color comes from ColorScheme.shadow at render time. Absent keys default per Shadows::default().

card.description: Subtle card lift. Default: blur=8, spread=0, offset_y=2, alpha=0.3

modal.description: Floating panel / dropdown. Default: blur=24, spread=0, offset_y=8, alpha=0.5

tooltip.description: Tooltip shadow. Default: blur=6, spread=0, offset_y=2, alpha=0.4

dropdown.description: Dropdown menu shadow. Default: blur=12, spread=0, offset_y=4, alpha=0.4

TreatmentsSection.title: Treatments
TreatmentsSection.description: Non-color behavioral flags. Boolean fields use BooleanToken; enum fields use StringToken; u8 fields use IntegerToken; f32 dimensions use DimensionToken. All fields optional — absent keys fall back to Treatments::default().

solid_active_fills.description: true = active/selected controls use solid fill (text-on-bg inversion). false = accent tint only. Default: false

hairline_borders.description: true = borders at Strokes.thin (0.5px). false = Strokes.std (1px). Default: false

uppercase_section_labels.description: true = section/group labels rendered in uppercase. Default: false

segmented_filled_idle.description: true = segmented control idle state uses filled background. false = outline-only. Default: false

focus_ring.description: Input focus ring style token. $value: "none" | "outline" | "glow". Default: "outline"

surface_bevel.description: Surface bevel treatment on button faces, panel headers, chips, inline tabs. $value: "none" | "raised" | "inset". none=flat fill (editorial/light); raised=top highlight+bottom shadow (Zed faces — Alto/Mariner); inset=sunken well (inputs/TF pills). Default: "none"

bevel_highlight_alpha.description: u8 0-255: Alpha of bevel top inner-highlight line. 0 = no highlight. Default: 0

bevel_shadow_alpha.description: u8 0-255: Alpha of bevel bottom inner-shadow line. 0 = no shadow. Default: 0

wl_row_side_margin.description: Horizontal inset (px) each side of a watchlist/list row. 0=flush rows; 6=Aperture pill rows; 4=Glass soft rows. Default: 0.0

wl_row_corner_radius.description: u8: Corner radius for list rows (px). 0=square; 99=full pill. Default: 0

wl_row_divider_alpha.description: u8 0-255: Alpha of per-row hairline bottom divider. 0=no divider. Default: 0

section_header_mono.description: true = section/eyebrow headers use monospace family (Alto/Mariner/Relay IBM Plex Mono style). Default: false

wl_symbol_mono.description: true = symbol text in list rows uses monospace family. Default: false

panel_tab_treatment.description: u8: Default tab treatment index for ui-kit Tabs widgets. 0=Line, 1=Segmented, 2=Filled, 3=Card, 4=Pane. Default: 0

pane_active_fill_accent.description: true = active pane header fills with accent color (Aperture signature). All text inside flips to contrast. Default: false

serif_headlines.description: true = serif family for hero numerics / display headings. Default: false

invert_active_fill.description: true = invert palette on active elements (fill=text, text=bg). Default: false

vertical_group_dividers.description: true = full-height vertical dividers between toolbar button clusters. Default: false

show_active_tab_underline.description: true = accent underline shown in tab bars. Default: true

inactive_header_fill.description: true = distinct recessed fill behind inactive pane headers. Default: true

nav_buttons_label_only.description: true = drop icon glyphs from right-side toolbar nav buttons. Default: false

nav_buttons_uppercase_labels.description: true = toolbar nav button labels rendered in ALL CAPS. Default: false

tab_underline_under_text.description: true = tab underline appears directly under active tab text. Default: false

card_floating_shadow.description: true = floating card shadow even when shadows_enabled=false. Default: false

shadows_enabled.description: Master toggle for drop shadows. Default: true

animations_enabled.description: false = snaps all animation instant (honours reduce-motion). Default: true

ChromeSection.title: Chrome
ChromeSection.description: Chrome geometry and finish tokens — toolbar/pane heights, divider alphas, indicator styles, focus-ring dimensions, drag handle, toast, shell regions, nav clusters, button groups. All palette-independent dimensions. Color comes from ColorScheme at render time. Absent keys fall back to Chrome::default().

toolbar_height_scale.description: Multiplier on toolbar height. 1.0=baseline, 1.4=Meridien tall. Default: 1.0

pane_gap.description: Gap between adjacent panes (px). >0 = tiled card layout. Default: 0.0

pane_gap_alpha.description: u8 0-255: Pane gap fill alpha. 0=transparent gutters (show canvas bg). Default: 0

active_header_fill_multiply.description: Active pane header fill gamma multiplier over bg. Default: 0.7

inactive_header_fill_multiply.description: Inactive pane header fill gamma multiplier. Default: 1.08

header_outer_border_alpha.description: u8 0-255: Alpha of hairline outer border around pane headers. Default: 38

header_outer_border_width.description: Stroke width of pane-header outer border (px). Default: 0.5

header_divider_alpha.description: u8 0-255: Alpha of inter-section vertical dividers inside pane header. Default: 50

nav_active_col_alpha.description: u8 0-255: Toolbar nav active-column tint alpha. Default: 0

dialog_backdrop_alpha.description: u8 0-255: Dialog/popup backdrop overlay alpha. 0=no backdrop. Default: 0

tab_inactive_alpha.description: f32 0.0-1.0: Inactive tab text alpha multiplier. Default: 0.55

tab_hover_bg_alpha.description: u8 0-255: Inactive-tab hover background alpha. Default: 18

drag_handle_alpha.description: f32 0.0-1.0: Drag handle (split divider) alpha multiplier. Default: 0.6

drag_handle_dot_scale.description: Drag handle dot size multiplier. Default: 1.0

toast_bg_alpha.description: u8 0-255: Toast / status-bar background alpha. Default: 220

card_stripe_alpha.description: u8 0-255: Stripe/accent-banner fill alpha for order/alert cards. Default: 255

card_floating_shadow_alpha.description: u8 0-255: Alpha for floating card shadow when enabled. Default: 0

accent_emphasis.description: f32: Saturation/brightness multiplier for accent on active elements. Default: 1.0

disabled_opacity.description: f32 0.0-1.0: Opacity multiplier for disabled widgets. Default: 0.5

region_gap.description: Gap (px) between major shell regions (top-nav, tool layer, workspace, right rail). 0=flush/contiguous chrome; 8=Aperture floating cards. Default: 0.0

region_radius.description: Corner radius (px) of each shell region card. 0=square. Default: 12.0

region_border_alpha.description: u8 0-255: Border alpha drawn around each shell region card. Default: 40

nav_cluster_radius.description: Corner radius (px) of a nav cluster background pill. 0=square. Default: 8.0

nav_cluster_fill_alpha.description: u8 0-255: Fill alpha of nav cluster background over toolbar surface. 0=transparent clusters. Default: 0

nav_cluster_padding.description: Horizontal inner padding (px) inside a nav cluster. Default: 6.0

button_group.description: Toolbar button-group enclosure style. $value: "none" | "bordered" | "frosted" | "sharp". none=flat (buttons spaced + hairline dividers, Meridien/Octave); bordered=rounded box with fill+hairline border (Aperture); frosted=fill-only no hard border (Glass); sharp=near-square border-only editorial outline (Lucid). Default: "none"

toolnav_height.description: Height (px) of second toolbar row (toolnav). 0=single-row chrome; >0=two-row (Aperture/Glass use ~30). Default: 0.0

footer_default_open.description: true = bottom dock is open by default for this style. User session override always wins. Default: false

panel_header_treatment.description: u8: Header toggle/tab treatment for side panels. 0=Line, 1=Segmented, 2=Filled, 3=Card, 4=Pane. Default: 0

panel_section_fill_alpha.description: u8 0-255: Fill alpha of a PanelSection body band over panel surface. 0=transparent/flat. Default: 0

panel_footer_card.description: true = pinned panel footer renders as elevated rounded card (ApertureJune P&L block). Default: false

panel_footer_radius.description: Corner radius (px) of pinned footer card. 0=square. Default: 10.0
